description:
Activate Ruthless Knave's first ability by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Gravecrawler dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer and Sifter of Skulls.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Knave ability from step 1, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Scion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may activate Ruthless Knave's last ability any number of times.
